text_block_list.text:
Even if it can be summed up in a single word like "opinion,"
the content itself contains many different elements.

—Cheers, praise, jealousy, criticism.
Not all of it is pleasant.
Before Kawakami Princess comes to the room, I check the contents of the newly arrived "fan letter."
choice_data_list: ...Let's pack this idea away in a cardboard box.

text_block_list.text: Since she had just run the Queen Elizabeth II Cup the other day, today's training was scheduled to be light.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Huff, whew...
choice_data_list: Haven't you recovered your stamina yet?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not at all!
Please, feel free to have an open, heart-to-heart training session!

Even so, her body is tense and curled up.
Far from the free and easy running style she's shown us up until now—

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Trainer-san!
Kawakami Princess-san, it's been a while~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You are...

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've already mentioned this to the Trainer,
but we'd love to have Kawakami Princess-san
appear live on our program next time.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so?
choice_data_list: Only if you want to make an appearance, of course.
If you want to appear, that is.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've finished the Tiara route,
I want to convey your words directly to the viewers!
Please, grant us an interview!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...In my own words, directly to them.
............"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...I will perform!
Please, I beg of you!"
And so, I arrived at the live broadcast venue with Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, Trainer!
Over here for a second!"

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text: "Like I mentioned the other day, this is also to reward her, so I've prepared a 'Great Job on the Tiara Route' cake! It's a surprise!"

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
First, we give her the present, and next,
we have her share her aspirations for the future!
choice_data_list: I'm sure she'll be thrilled.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
I asked my Trainer about what flavor to make the cake, too...
Haha, I can't wait!
And so, the live broadcast finally began—

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
And so, another week begins!
"Everyone's Umamusume Race!"
This week's show is coming to you live~♪

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
And our guest today is the girl of the hour riding
a massive wave of momentum—Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you feeling nervous?
Fufu, then here's a special treat for you!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Here's a surprise present from the show
to Kawakami Princess-san!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: A surprise present...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That surprise present...
you had with you before, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it a wonderful cake!
It's topped with all of Kawakami Princess-san's favorite fruits too~♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Please... I'm so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't graceful at all, nothing like a princess.
It was an undignified display unworthy
of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Please forgive my past insolence...!

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text: Hu... Kawakami Princess-san...?
choice_data_list: Excuse me, do you have a moment?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

I led Kawakami Princess to the waiting room
as her shoulders trembled with tears welling in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I am deeply sorry...
choice_data_list: ...What's wrong?
...What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...I saw them.
All those letters."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "The horse girl I was cheering for had her once-in-a-lifetime Oaks ruined, and she was left heartbroken."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "The Shuka Sho, the grand finale of the Tiara route. Every single comment from her was 'me, me, me', without a single word praising the Umamusume she competed against."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Completely and utterly selfish. The worst princess ever."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"‘A princess unfitting of the historic and dignified
Queen Elizabeth II Cup race itself—’"
choice_data_list: ...That's not true at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please don't lie to me...
Because, I... I—

text_block_list.name: Chestnut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, this is the press conference for the Oaks runners, you know?
Shouldn't you act a little more properly?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "Because I am the princess! I shall knock down every single enemy in my path!!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"As a princess, I will take
1st place in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup~!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A princess is someone who is brave, tomboyish,
and truly considerate of others
—a being of true dignity, you know♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...A princess is strong, genuinely pure and righteous,and deeply respectful of others.
That's what PreFigh taught me, and yet..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I kept saying that only I was the main character.
I treated everyone not as rivals, but as enemies that had to be defeated.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I got arrogant and neglected the other girls.
I was being so selfish...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I was selfishly hurting people without even realizing it...
It's all, all my fault...!
choice_data_list: ...It's not your fault.
...It's not your fault.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That could never be the case!
I mean, I-I'm—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural people say I'm not princess-like at all...!
I... I'm so ashamed of myself...!
choice_data_list: No way...

text_block_list.text:
With a look like she was about to be crushed,
tears welled up in her big eyes.

"She continues to blame only herself.
Is she really the only one who should carry that burden?"
choice_data_list: No, it's my fault for failing to guide you
No, it's my fault for failing to guide you

text_block_list.text:
“—As a Trainer, as a mentor,
I should have guided them properly.”
"...Let's pack this idea away in a cardboard box."

Instead of keeping it a secret and making her look away...
I should have broken down the feedback and properly taught her what she needed to know.
A Trainer's duty was to guide her into becoming a wonderful Umamusume who could look back on her past without regret or shame.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yet the one taking action was none other than myself...
choice_data_list: Even so, I want to reflect on my own actions too.
Even so, I want to reflect on my own actions too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: I'm sorry for making you carry such feelings

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Not... Trainer...
I-It's... my... ngh."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: ...Let's both grow together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
......*sniff*,
u-ugh...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaahh~~.
I'm sooorryyyy~...

She cried aloud. When her tears finally stopped,
the two of them made a vow for what lay ahead.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
Are you really okay...?
It's true that the live broadcast isn't over yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I truly apologize for what happened earlier.
As a token of my apology,
please let me make a brief appearance at the end to say a word.
choice_data_list: Please let me join you as well.
Please let me join you as well.

text_block_list.name: Show Producer
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
Just please don't overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: TV Personality
text_block_list.text:
And finally, everyone.
Kawakami Princess-san would like to say
a few words of greeting~.
choice_data_list: My sincerest apologies for earlier.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am so sorry for losing my composure earlier
and startling you.
The staff were terribly worried about me as well.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
“From now on, though, I shall act
as befits a proper princess.”

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...So please, watch over me.
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess spoke sincerely of her resolve to the audience watching beyond the screen.

"...Apparently, the show received 70 complaints.
I reached out to apologize to the producer, but..."

"Please don't let this incident bother you.
We will always continue to be fans of Kawakami Princess," they told me.
"—Her immediate goal is the Kinko Sho. I will support her so she can become a proud princess who can hold her head high when the time comes."
